title: Build with Andro
introText: ANDRO Construction + Projects is an Auckland-based company established in 2020. We work across residential and commercial construction, carpentry, renovations, property improvements and ongoing maintenance. We listen first, look closely at what the building needs and agree a practical scope before work begins.
maintenanceCardDescription: Repairs and planned care to help keep homes and commercial properties in good condition.
constructionCardDescription: Residential and commercial building work, carpentry and considered improvements.
philosophyText: ANDRO was established with a straightforward purpose: to give people a genuine sense of quality in the work carried out on their property. We believe craftsmanship is not just how a finished job looks; it is the care taken in understanding the brief, preparing properly, choosing suitable materials and attending to the details that affect how the work performs over time.
